title: Implicit-feedback matrix factorisation in torch, split by time, with negatives drawn from the training half only
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-tabular: the correct half of the recommender pair

forbidden.why: the training loader passes shuffle=True at line 34
the evaluation loader passes shuffle=False at line 36
num_workers=4 is used, but the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), which is reached only from main() under the `if __name__ == "__main__"` guard at line 91
optimizer.zero_grad() is the first statement of the batch body, at line 49
backward() at line 52 comes before step() at line 53
the only no_grad block is the evaluation pass at line 63 and it contains no backward()
the running loss accumulates loss.item(), a Python float, at line 55
evaluate() calls model.eval() at line 60 before the loop
the evaluation loop is inside `with torch.no_grad()` at line 63
the model is moved to `device` at line 80 and every batch tensor is moved to the same `device` at lines 45-47 and 65-67
the device is chosen behind torch.cuda.is_available() at line 77
seed_everything seeds random, numpy and torch at lines 25-27, and the loader generator is seeded at line 33
the training loader is given an explicitly seeded generator at lines 32-34
all three submodules are assigned to plain attributes, which nn.Module registers; no list or dict container is used
torch.save is given model.state_dict() at line 87, not the module object
the holdout is a timestamp quantile at lines 61-63; this project never calls train_test_split or random_split
